candidateStrata.note: 2014 text repeatedly treats 文萌樓 not merely as a preserved object but as an active spatial device: an anti-abolition movement '發動機', later an '入口網站' for livelihood, then a social-learning space. Record only as a candidate stratum around place-as-operating-interface; no theoretical integration yet.

2014 journal draft explicitly separates private ownership from public history ('文萌樓雖然是私人財產，但是歷史卻是公共財') while tracking how heritage status and development rights become monetizable. Record as candidate material concerning ownership/history/value without comparing it to later value-form work.

The same 2014 layer describes urban renewal as selectively preserving approved traditional industries while erasing the sex-industry past as a 'negative' element, including the phrase '紅燈區變都更區'. Candidate stratum: selective historical visibility / erasure. No synthesis yet.
